title: Chart-CNN stock selection in a large-cap book

claim.signal: a convolutional neural network trained on price-chart images selects stocks with information incremental to momentum, short-term reversal, size, value, and volatility
claim.universe: point-in-time S&P 500 constituents; value-weighted long-short portfolio
claim.claimed_effect: the chart-CNN delivers positive, cost-robust incremental return beyond the book's existing factors
claim.source: Jiang, Kelly and Xiu (2023) chart-image CNN claim, tested in a SequoAlpha large-cap implementation
claim.data_needs: point-in-time S&P 500 membership, daily OHLCV, factor legs built in the same universe, and trained-model predictions

protocol.replication_anchor: recreate the original QuantConnect Research pipeline with the point-in-time large-cap universe; keep the chronological split and evaluate the already-specified factor-spanning regression
protocol.kill_criteria_for_the_claim: the sealed 2020-2024 holdout has non-positive or statistically indistinguishable spanning alpha after the five in-universe factor controls, or realistic turnover costs remove the gross result

verdict.outcome: NEGATIVE in the tested large-cap monthly setting — validation spanning alpha of +0.68% per month (t=2.41) became -0.29% (t=-0.62) on the once-opened 2020-2024 holdout; high monthly turnover made the holdout negative at every tested cost level.
verdict.replication: evidence-only retrofit: the original source report, source regression suite, split logic, and evaluation logic are fingerprinted here; this repository does not claim a new numerical recomputation.

diagnostics.sealed_holdout: the same construction that looked promising in validation reversed sign and lost significance on the untouched holdout
diagnostics.spanning: the holdout alpha is statistically indistinguishable from zero after momentum, short-term reversal, size, value, and volatility controls
diagnostics.costs: validation long-short Sharpe fell from 1.10 gross to 0.53 at 10 bps one-way and about zero at 20 bps with 184% monthly turnover; the holdout was negative from gross through 20 bps
diagnostics.interpretation: the source study attributes the validation result to early-stopping optimism and a favourable short sample; this is an evidence-backed diagnosis, not a new causal estimate

honest_limitations: this is a source-evidence retrofit: raw point-in-time QuantConnect data, trained-model outputs, and portfolio return files are unavailable here, so Verdict cannot freshly recompute the reported numbers

the original holdout was sealed and opened once in the source project, but that event predates Verdict's machine-readable ledger; this repository must not present the import as a newly enforced physical seal
the negative result applies to the tested value-weighted, large-cap, monthly configuration and does not refute the source paper's broader, equal-weighted and weekly settings
the source report describes high turnover and a simple one-way-cost sensitivity; it is not a full execution or market-impact study
